# JobPrep

> JobPrep is an AI-powered, multi-provider career-preparation platform: an AI CV
> builder, mock interviews with live video avatars, a coding-challenge arena, and
> a provider-agnostic AI Coach (Claude, GPT, Gemini, or local Ollama). Built with
> Next.js 15, Prisma/PostgreSQL, Better-Auth, and the Vercel AI SDK.

## Key concepts

- AI Coach: a single provider-agnostic chat surface backed by a model registry.
  Select a model with a `<provider>:<model>` id (e.g. `anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5`,
  `openai:gpt-4o-mini`, `gemini:gemini-2.0-flash`, `ollama:llama3.2`). The default
  is `claude-haiku-4-5`, configurable via `AI_COACH_DEFAULT_MODEL`.
- CV Builder: section-based résumé editor with AI enhancement and PDF export.
- Mock Interviews: question generation, answer evaluation, and a LiveKit + Simli
  video avatar interviewer (the avatar agent runs as a Python container, not on
  Cloudflare Workers).
- Coding Arena: in-browser code editor with execution via Judge0/Piston.

## API

- API reference (interactive): `/api-docs`
- OpenAPI document: `/api/openapi`
- AI Coach (streaming): `POST /api/ai/coach` with `{ messages, model? }`
- Available models: `GET /api/ai/models`
- Health/config status: `GET /api/health`
